title: Ben and Holly’s Little Kingdom
description: English dubbing scenes from Ben and Holly’s Little Kingdom.
author: Parrotbook

scenes.title: 我看起来怎么样？
quotes: Oh no! The magic hat has turned Ben blue!
哦，不！魔法帽把本变蓝了！
How do I look?
我看起来怎么样？
Um, I think your old hat suits you better.
嗯，我觉得你原来的帽子更适合你。
Me too.
我也这么觉得。
Abracazobody!
阿布拉卡佐波迪！（剧中的魔法咒语）
Ah, it's good to have my old hat back again.
啊，能重新戴上我的旧帽子真好。
And it's nice to have you back, wand. I will never lose you again.
魔法棒，你也回来了，真好。我再也不会把你弄丢了。

scenes.title: 精灵从来不害怕！
quotes: Sorry, Ben. Were you scared?
对不起，本。你害怕了吗？
I'm an elf. Elves are never scared.
我是精灵。精灵从来不害怕。
Er, good. In that case, can I try again?
呃，那就好。那我可以再试一次吗？
Um, maybe later. See you!
嗯，待会儿再说吧。再见！
Bye, Ben.
再见，本。

scenes.title: 我可以和本一起玩吗？
quotes: But Nanny Plum, I was going to play with Ben.
可是梅姨，我本来打算和本一起玩。
Princess Holly, there's a time for playing with elves and a time for wand practice.
霍莉公主，和精灵玩有玩的时间，练习魔法棒有练习的时间。
Please, Nanny. I promise to practise later.
求你了，梅姨。我保证待会儿练习。
Hmm, very well, but come in when I—
嗯，好吧，不过等我叫你时就——
Thanks, Nanny. Bye!
谢谢梅姨。再见！

scenes.title: 我的魔法出了一点错
scenes.english: My magic went a bit wrong
quotes: Gosh! What a big hat!
哎呀！好大的一顶帽子！
Er, it's Ben. I accidentally turned him into a hat.
呃，那是本。我不小心把他变成帽子了。
Princess Holly, that's exactly why you need to practise your magic more.
霍莉公主，这正是你需要多练习魔法的原因。
I was practising, but it all went a bit wrong.
我刚才就在练习，可是出了一点错。

scenes.title: 我有一个简单的计划
scenes.english: I have got a simple plan
quotes: But Ben, how are you going to find my wand?
可是，本，你要怎么找到我的魔法棒呢？
I've got a simple plan.
我有一个简单的计划。
Oh, goody!
哦，太好啦！
First, try to remember where you left your wand. In your bedroom, perhaps.
首先，想想你把魔法棒放在哪里了。也许在你的卧室里？
Or in the meadow. That's where I left it.
或者在草地上。我就是把它落在那里了。
Ah.
啊。
What's the next bit of your plan?
你的计划下一步是什么呢？
Um, that was the plan.
呃，这就是整个计划了。
